title: Boundary blow-up solutions: gradient asymptotics and uniqueness
summary: Let $Ω\subset\mathbb R^n$ be a bounded domain, and let $f$ be a nonnegative, nondecreasing function satisfying the Keller-Osserman condition. We study boundary blow-up solutions of $Δu=f(u)$ in $Ω$. Although existence is classical, uniqueness under these assumptions is known in balls but remains open even for smooth convex domains. We identify the normalized gradient $Q_u=|\nabla u|^2/(2F(u))$, $F'=f$, as a quantity governing uniqueness.
